hook: Your train could be a pod in a tube.
title: India Built a Hyperloop Test Track
description:
IIT Madras built a hyperloop test track in India. The idea is a pod travelling inside a sealed low-air tube to cut drag. It is only a test track so far, but it is real.

#Shorts #Hyperloop #India
comment_prompt: Would you ride it? Yes or no
